messages:
aj: Quick sync — DevExp shiproom checklist. Who's owning final signoffs and what deps block the SDK/docs/sample apps?
marie: I can own docs freeze and release notes. Planning to cut the changelog at EOD Thu UTC. Need final API surface from SDK team by Wed noon.
sam: SDK owner here. Targeting RC by Wed 18:00 UTC. blockers: eng-runtime proto change (ENG-RUNTIME-521) and a CI flake on macOS.
leo: eng-runtime here. Proto change is merged to main but needs a compatibility test. ETA for test -> Thurs morning. We can feature-flag if SDK needs a workaround.
tanya: Sample apps owner. We have 3 PRs blocked on SDK RC: sample-apps#42, #45, #47. If SDK RC lands by Wed evening we can merge Thurs. Also need updated quickstart snippets in docs.
aj: So owners: sam -> SDK RC, marie -> docs/changelog freeze, tanya -> sample apps merge, leo -> runtime compatibility test. I'll coordinate rollback/fallback policy if runtime test fails.
marie: Docs checklist: update quickstart snippets, add migration note for the proto change, and annotate breaking changes in CHANGELOG.md. I'll open the changelog PR once I get SDK release notes.
sam: CI plan: we'll run nightly against runtime compat branch and post results here. If tests pass by Thu 12:00 UTC, we go RC -> final. Otherwise RC stays and we mark breaking migration.
leo: Note: there's a perf regression on long context in the runtime branch, but it's orthogonal to proto change. We'll open ENG-RUNTIME-533 for that. Not blocking the RC.
tanya: Quickstarts: I'll prepare a small note with commands to repro local dev: ```bash
# start local quickstart
git clone https://github.com/redwood/sample-apps.git
cd sample-apps/quickstart
pip install -r requirements.txt
REDWOOD_API_KEY=... ./run_local.sh
```
Please confirm env variable name matches SDK exports.
sam: env var should be REDWOOD_API_KEY for now, yes. We'll include snippet in SDK README and a small compatibility table for 2.x -> 3.x in CHANGELOG.
docs-bot: New PR created: docs/changelog/1794501234 by marie — https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/213 :page_facing_up: 
aj: Ping for reviews: @sam (SDK), @leo (runtime), @marie (docs), @tanya (sample apps). Can we aim for an all-green shiproom by Fri 15:00 UTC?
marie: That works for docs timeline. I'll freeze the changelog at EOD Thu unless something big lands.
sam: Agree. I'll post the RC artifact link here once CI passes: `s3://redwood-sdk/2.3.0-rc1.tar.gz`.
leo: If tests fail, I'll prioritize the compat fix first thing Thu. Will update here with ENG-RUNTIME-521 status.
tanya: I'll queue sample-apps smoke tests against the RC when sam posts the artifact. Thanks all :thumbsup:
aj: Perfect. I'll write a short shiproom checklist doc and share in #all-hands before Fri. If anything slips, we revert sample-app merges behind feature flags.
marie: small ask: can SDK team add a tiny example of streaming usage in quickstart? It's been a common question.
sam: Yep — will add a 6-line streaming example in the README and quickstart snippet.
marie: sweet, thanks.
aj: Closing notes: owners pinned, major deps tracked: ENG-RUNTIME-521 (compat test), SDK RC, sample-apps PRs, changelog freeze. I'll follow up with a short Loom for shiproom.
leo: noted.
tanya: ack.
sam: ack.
marie: ack.
